scope: Standard physical returns and related communication. Case-bound evidence and applicable site policy determine eligibility, fees and deadlines. Special settlements require explicit authorization. Local human-reviewed drafts only; no business execution.

sources.authority: Current public policy for the identified site; retrieval time is not effective time. Conflicts or historical applicability require review.
Verified, enabled site/intent bindings only. Preserve individually agreed terms; surface conflicts with public policy.
Process and examples only. Example prices, concessions and alternatives are not general authorization.
Scoped conversation and current identity-verified facts; customer reports, agent promises and confirmed executions are distinct.

interpretation_rules: Read the prior agent questions together with the customer's answers. A concise reply can satisfy several requested conditions without repeating their exact wording.

For ordinary fit issues, evaluate the overall state confirmation in context. Do not invent damage or require a separate undamaged statement merely because a checklist word was omitted. Concrete ambiguity or a damage allegation must be assessed, not ignored.
Keep eligibility separate from offer preparation. Missing fee details or a final address do not undo satisfied condition checks.

Use the first return-request date, not today's date or the date of an internal followup. Do not penalize customers for internal delays. Near-boundary dates and timezone uncertainty require specific review.
Standard size-chart measurements stored on an order do not by themselves establish a custom-size purchase.
An ordinary eligible return proposal can be drafted for human approval without an already executed approval action. Do not invent special keep-item compensation or donation options.
A request to return is not acceptance of an offer that has never been presented. Conditional acceptance is not unconditional acceptance.

Preserve advanced stages: accepted offer, dispatched return, receipt/inspection and refund execution are distinct. Do not restart initial eligibility questions after an evidenced agreement or dispatch.
Unknown or conflicting eligibility goes to specific clarification or exception review, never automatic rejection. Customer claims and business confirmations must remain distinguishable.

Track each requested item and issue. A multi-item order may have mixed eligibility; do not extend one item's result or refund amount to the whole order. Unresolved item scope requires specific review.
A changed offer requires fresh agreement to the new terms. Do not treat acceptance of an earlier amount or destination as acceptance of a replacement offer.
Customer-reported arrival damage or a missing seal at arrival is a separate claim, not automatic proof of customer misuse or automatic ordinary-return rejection.

For any conflict discovered after an agreement or dispatch, preserve the advanced stage and agreed history, record the specific exception and require internal review before a ready reply. Do not reset the checklist.
Never mark a customer report of delivery or a promised refund as verified warehouse receipt, inspection, gateway execution or customer settlement.

Readiness is separate from stage: investigation complete, draft approved and business action complete are different outcomes. A ready draft still requires human approval and does not perform any action.

conversation.gap: Incomplete or conflicting history requires targeted investigation; never assert no_reply from incomplete history.

policy.gap: No historical policy archive. Unknown effective date, unsupported site or conflicting sources require review.

order.gap: Identity check exists; complete currency, discounts and original fee allocation are not guaranteed. Do not infer them.

documents.gap: Reads existing supported documents/OCR only. No return-form generation, attachment preparation or general visual damage verification.

destination.gap: Obtain complete case-applicable address from verified guidance; no dedicated destination lookup or automatic address verification.

return_tracking.gap: The tool reports capability gaps and extracted references; no actual return-carrier lookup is configured.

warehouse.gap: No warehouse receipt/inspection adapter. Postal tracking or customer claims cannot establish warehouse inspection.

refund_execution.gap: Order refund summaries do not prove gateway execution or settlement. No gateway query or refund execution tool.

routing_semantics: Evaluate in array order; the first matching rule wins. Within when, positions, condition_statuses and exception_present are alternatives (OR). The final always rule is the only fallback. Reassess on new scoped evidence; these are stage selections, not executed transitions.

edges.event: 必要条件充分确认且适用政策支持
条件不符、冲突或具体例外
客户明确接受已提出的同一方案
条款争议、方案变更需授权
取得证据或授权后提出适用方案
仅剩影响决定的客户事实待确认
客户报告寄回；不等同于承运商已收件
报告或核实送达；分别标注证据等级

collect_conditions.goal: Ask only genuinely missing eligibility questions; do not repeat answered questions.
collect_conditions.template:
Hello,

Thank you for the details. [Acknowledge the relevant facts already supplied.]

[Ask only the specific unanswered question that changes the return decision, and explain why if necessary.]

[Explain the next step once that information is received.]

Kind regards,
[Site customer service signature]
entry: Ordinary return request with genuinely missing eligibility facts, before agreement or dispatch.

completion.analysis: Identify each known/missing/conflicting condition and first request date with scoped evidence.
completion.draft: Ask only the missing customer facts that affect the decision; internal API/policy gaps are internal followups.
completion.business: Relevant answers arrive; reassess using applicable policy. Sending a question is not completion of eligibility.

exceptions.when: Policy, identity or relevant item cannot be established.
exceptions.action: Record the exact internal gap, preserve customer-supplied facts and hold readiness if it changes the decision.

offer_options.goal: Conditions have been confirmed: provide the applicable return proposal and ask for acceptance. This is a draft proposal for human review, not executed approval.
offer_options.template:
Hello,

Thank you for confirming the condition of the dress. [Acknowledge the fit problem briefly.]

[Present the applicable return option: evidenced item amount or exact supported refund basis, the designated destination when known, original-fee exclusions and who pays return postage.]

[Explain the evidenced receipt/inspection conditions before refund processing.]

Please let us know whether you would like to proceed with this option. [Explain that final return instructions and any actually required documents follow confirmation; do not claim files are attached.]

Kind regards,
[Site customer service signature]
data_rules: Exact net amount needs evidenced currency, item scope, discounts and deductions. Never subtract guessed fees from a paid total.

If exact fee allocation is unavailable but current policy clearly defines the refund basis, explain that basis without inventing numbers. Mark exact amount as an internal review gap; do not fall back to generic waiting.
The full street address and shipping documents belong to RET-03, not prerequisites for explaining an evidenced RET-02 return option.
Only include alternatives expressly supported by applicable policy or case authorization. Do not copy example percentages or waive a fee from an example template.
offer_options.label_zh: 提出退货方案并确认选择
entry: Conditions satisfied in context; no acceptance of an existing offer.
Conditional acceptance remains negotiation unless a specific exception needs review.

completion.analysis: Establish eligible item scope, refund basis, supported fees and actual customer position.
completion.draft: Present the supported option, costs, receipt/inspection terms and request an explicit choice. Exact amount only with sufficient allocation and currency.
completion.business: Customer explicitly accepts the actual proposed terms; a draft proposal or generic return request is not acceptance.

exceptions.when: Exact fee breakdown or currency is missing but policy basis is clear.
exceptions.action: Explain the evidenced refund basis without a guessed number; keep allocation as an internal followup.

exceptions.when: Policy conflicts, special compensation or changed terms need approval.
exceptions.action: Seek case-bound authorization; do not copy example percentages or waive fees.

send_instructions.goal: Customer accepted an evidenced offer: give the matching final return instructions. If executable details are unavailable, retain this stage and flag internal preparation.
send_instructions.template:
Hello,

Thank you for confirming your choice. [Restate the agreed return terms without adding deductions.]

[Provide the verified complete destination and actual available shipping instructions/documents.]

[Request the tracking number after dispatch and explain the evidenced next step.]

Kind regards,
[Site customer service signature]
send_instructions.label_zh: 发送核实后的寄回指引
entry: Customer explicitly accepts an evidenced offer; identify which items and version of terms were accepted.

completion.analysis: Preserve accepted terms; identify current complete destination and all actually applicable shipping/document requirements.
completion.draft: Supply verified address and usable instructions. Claim an attachment only when it actually exists and is included. Missing execution details mean holding/internal_review.
completion.business: Approved instructions were actually sent, and later shipment evidence starts tracking. Draft generation alone is not dispatch.

exceptions.when: Address, required documents, item identity or agreed terms are missing/conflicting.
exceptions.action: Retain send_instructions; prepare the specific missing details internally and block ready instructions.

track_return.goal: Customer reports dispatch: acknowledge supplied tracking/documents, check return capability and identify receipt/inspection followup. Do not repeat offer acceptance or eligibility questions.
track_return.template:
Hello,

Thank you for the return update. [Acknowledge the actual supplied tracking or documents without treating them as delivery proof.]

[Explain the current verified status and receipt/inspection next step under the agreed terms.]

Kind regards,
[Site customer service signature]
track_return.label_zh: 跟踪已报告寄回的包裹
entry: Customer reports dispatch or scoped evidence establishes it; retain original agreement even if earlier checklist facts are absent.

completion.analysis: Separate reported dispatch, postal reference, carrier acceptance and delivery evidence. Inspect supplied documents before asking again.
completion.draft: Acknowledge supplied evidence and explain the actual next step and query limits. Do not imply a carrier/warehouse lookup succeeded when unavailable.
completion.business: Carrier or warehouse returns independently verified progress; a receipt image alone does not complete delivery.

exceptions.when: Carrier query unavailable, parcel delayed or delivery disputed.
exceptions.action: Create an internal followup in the analysis for actual investigation; do not claim a followup task was created by this drafting workflow.

review_refund.goal: Assess evidenced warehouse receipt, inspection or payment result; distinguish a customer delivery claim from verified warehouse receipt and gateway execution.
review_refund.template:
Hello,

[State only the evidenced return, inspection or refund stage.]

[Explain the actual remaining step or verified result without inventing payment execution or settlement timing.]

Kind regards,
[Site customer service signature]
review_refund.label_zh: 核查收货、质检与退款进度
entry: A return-receipt or refund result is reported or evidenced; this stage is for verification and is not itself execution proof.

completion.analysis: Distinguish delivery claim, warehouse receipt, inspection, agreed amount, gateway submission and settlement. Check actual existing refund/dispute evidence before proposing execution.
completion.draft: State only the supported processing status, unchanged agreed terms and actual remaining action. Gateway execution cannot be asserted by this workflow.
completion.business: Authorized operator and authoritative warehouse/payment evidence confirm the relevant completion. A promise, aggregate refund field or no new customer message does not prove settlement.

exceptions.when: Receipt, inspection, payment or dispute status cannot be verified.
exceptions.action: Record the specific missing confirmation and refer to warehouse/payments as appropriate; do not invent execution or timing.

exception_review.goal: Explain or clarify the specific conflict/exception. Preserve ordinary return claims alongside quality disputes; never auto-reject or invent an exception.
exception_review.template:
Hello,

[Acknowledge the customer's problem and the relevant facts.]

[Explain the specific unresolved issue and ask only for evidence that is necessary, or describe the internal action required.]

Kind regards,
[Site customer service signature]
entry: Outside ordinary conditions, conflicting policies/facts, mixed item scope, or a specific requested exception before advanced progress.

completion.analysis: Name the actual disputed fact or term, preserve ordinary return and quality claims, and identify the role able to resolve it.
completion.draft: Give targeted clarification or an evidenced explanation. Do not reject automatically or invent an approved alternative.
completion.business: New evidence or explicit scoped authorization resolves the issue; reassess while preserving agreed/executed history.

exceptions.when: No supported policy, authority or integration can resolve the issue.
exceptions.action: Hold internally with a concrete missing decision; record a candidate knowledge gap for later review.

maintenance.change_policy: Candidate change -> version bump -> structure/routing tests -> semantic model replay -> scoped human review -> local release/rollback. AI may propose; it must not self-publish policy or infer case exceptions as rules.
maintenance.feedback_policy: Opted-in factual/process/template feedback may produce an unapproved knowledge candidate through knowledge:synthesize-ticket-feedback. Individual decisions remain case-bound. Add a deidentified regression case for each confirmed failure.
release_requirements: All deterministic cases pass; no unknown nodes/tools or missing exception exits.
Run semantic replays for changed paths and inspect business meaning independently of AI review.
Review authority, applicable site/effective date and preservation of existing commitments.
Retain prior version and run evidence; repository publication and production acceptance are separate.
